title: SOC Analyst (L1 / L2)
jobDescription: Key Objectives: ● Analysts in Security Operations work with Security Engineers and SOC Managers to give situational awareness via detection,containment, and remediation of IT threats. ● It can be a dynamic role. SOC Analysts cooperate with other team members to detect and respond to information security incidents, develop and follow security events such as alerts, and engage in security investigations. ● Build reports, work with SOC tools and software to build use cases for incidents. What Innspark is Looking For: Experience Level: 0-1 years [desirable] or more. Note: We are looking to hire freshers and we will be providing training and internship on their joining. Skills [Optional]: ● Technically adept at understanding and working with SIEM and advanced security tools and products. [Desirable] ●Knowledge of SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) ●Familiar with SQL, C, C++, C#, Java, or PHP programming languages. ●TCP/IP, computer networking, routing, and switching. ●IDS/IPS, penetration and vulnerability testing. ●Firewall and intrusion detection/prevention protocols ●Windows, UNIX, and Linux operating systems. ●Network protocols and packet analysis tools. ●Anti-virus and anti-malware. Soft Skills: ● Professional working proficiency in spoken and written English. ● Professional working proficiency in spoken Hindi. Educational Background [Optional]: ● BTech/MCA/BCA/MSc/BSc in computer science or applications or any other related computer field. [desired] ● Any other Engineering background aka. a degree in Engineering or diploma in any branch of Engineering.

title: Flutter Developer
jobDescription:
Apply via the Innspark careers page. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Design and develop embedded systems using microcontrollers, FPGAs, and real-time firmware. • Create and optimize low-level software in C/C++ for embedded applications. • Develop and test analog and digital circuits for UAVs and other electronic systems. • Perform power calculations to ensure energy-efficient designs and manage power systems such as Li Po and Li-ion batteries. • Implement communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, MAVLink) for seamless hardware-software integration. • Debug embedded systems using tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG. • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, circuit diagrams, and test procedures. • Stay updated with the latest technologies and industry standards in embedded systems and electronics. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. A Master’s degree can be advantageous, especially for more specialized roles. Experience: • Minimum 2 years of proven experience in embedded systems development, including hardware-software integration, programming, debugging, and testing. • Hands-on experience in electronic circuit design and PCB layout tools (e.g., Altium Designer, Ki Cad, Eagle). • Experience with communication protocols (I2C, SPI, UART, CAN) and embedded real-time systems. • Experience in preparing and maintaining technical documentation, including circuit diagrams and test procedures. • Experience in electronic systems development for UAVs or similar technologies is highly desirable. Skills: • Proficiency in embedded programming languages (C/C++, Python) and low-level software development. • Familiarity with PCB design tools and embedded system debugging tools (oscilloscopes, logic analyzers). • Knowledge of power electronics and battery management systems. Abilities: • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on quality and attention to detail. • Self-motivated with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks. If you’re passionate about embedded systems and have the skills to match, we’d love to hear from you. Join our team and be part of a company that values innovation, creativity, and excellence in electronic system design. C++ Engineer Qt-based Application Development (Drone / UAS development) Job Title : C++ Engineer (Qt-based Application Development) Location : Kerala Employment Type : Full-Time Experience Level : Minimum 2 year Job Overview: We are seeking a skilled software Engineer with proficiency in C++ to design, develop, and maintain both frontend and backend application for next-generation drone and UAV operation. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Qt and QML technologies, along with a strong background in software development for Linux embedded platforms. This role requires a proactive individual who is self-motivated and capable of working independently or as part of a collaborative team. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Implement user-friendly interfaces for mission planning, flight monitoring, and data visualization using C++ and Qt framework. ● Implement robust communication protocols for reliable data exchange between GCS and drone/UAV. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate UAV operational requirements into functional GCS features. ● Integrate various onboard sensor data feeds (GPS, Li DAR, IMU, etc.) for real-time situational awareness. ● Develop autonomous flight algorithms for waypoint navigation, obstacle avoidance, and dynamic mission execution. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver optimized software solutions. ● Utilize Git for version control, ensuring clear documentation and well-managed codebases. ● Stay up-to-date with industry standards and best practices. ● Knowledge of developing communication protocols and data exchange mechanisms. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
❖ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. A higher degree or specialization can be advantageous but not typically required. Experience: ● Minimum of 2 years of experience in software development with a strong focus on C++ and Qt framework. ● Minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in application development using Qt and QML technologies. ● Experience in software development for Linux embedded platforms. ● Solid understanding of MAVLink or similar UAV communication protocols ● Previous work with drone or UAV technology would be highly beneficial. Skills: Strong understanding of C++ and object-oriented programming. ● Proficiency with Qt and QML for frontend and backend application Development. ● Familiarity with code versioning tools, particularly Git. ● Experience with tools and methodologies that ensure high-quality code delivery (e.g., static analysis, code reviews, testing frameworks). ● Ability to design intuitive and user-friendly interfaces, considering the complex functionalities of a GCS that caters to both novice and expert users. ● Understanding of modular and scalable software architecture, essential for developing complex software systems like a GCS. Abilities: ● Ability to work independently and as part of a team. ● Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on quality and attention to detail. ● Self-motivated with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks. If you’re passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and have the skills to match, we’d love to hear from you. Join our team and be part of a company that values innovation and creativity. Computer Vision Engineer (Drone / UAS development) Job Title : Computer Vision Engineer Location : Kerala Employment Type : Full-Time Experience Level : Minimum 2 year Job Overview: We are looking for a computer vision Engineer with a proven track record of integrating advanced algorithms into scalable, real-world solutions. This role involves designing robust software architectures, optimizing performance for edge devices, and addressing complex challenges related to UAV navigation, object detection, and multi-sensor integration. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
❖ Lead the integration of cutting-edge computer vision and deep learning algorithms into UAV systems. ❖ Implement advanced techniques for vision-based UAV navigation, object detection, tracking, and obstacle avoidance. ❖ Design and implement flexible, real-time vision systems that can integrate with multi-modal sensor inputs (cameras, radar, GPS, etc.). ❖ Develop strategies to enhance the performance of vision algorithms using hardware accelerators such as Open CL, CUDA, or FPGA. ❖ Architect efficient solutions for deploying deep learning and computer vision algorithms on edge devices with limited resources. ❖ Implement real-time sensor fusion for navigation, obstacle avoidance, and other UAV functions. ❖ Optimize inference performance for edge computing platforms and ensure real-time decision-making. ❖ Conduct performance benchmarking and optimize inference pipelines to achieve low latency and high throughput on embedded platforms. ❖ Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation, including system design, implementation guidelines, and performance evaluation reports. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
❖ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. ❖ Strong academic background in computer vision, deep learning, and embedded systems. Experience: ❖ Minimum 2 years of proven experience in designing and developing computer vision and deep learning solutions. ❖ Experience in deploying computer vision systems on UAVs, ADAS, robotics, or other autonomous systems. ❖ Experience working with multi-modal sensor data (camera, radar, GPS, IMU, etc.) and sensor fusion for real-time applications. Skills: ❖ Proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as Tensor Flow, Py Torch, or equivalent. ❖ Strong expertise in computer vision algorithms, including object detection, tracking, and obstacle avoidance. ❖ Experience with edge computing, deploying solutions on embedded devices, and optimizing for real-time processing. ❖ Knowledge of hardware acceleration techniques using Open CL, CUDA, or similar technologies. ❖ Understanding of UAV dynamics and flight planning. ❖ Experience working with UAV platforms such as PX4 or Ardu Pilot. ❖ Familiarity with drone communication protocols (MAVLink, ROS, etc.). Abilities: ❖ Ability to work independently and as part of a team. ❖ Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on quality and attention to detail. ❖ Self-motivated with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks. If you’re passionate about cutting-edge UAV technology and have the expertise in computer vision systems, we’d love to hear from you. Join our team and help us revolutionize the future of autonomous drone systems with advanced computer vision solutions! Technical Content Writer Job Summary: We are looking for a talented and Creative Content Writer to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for producing high-quality and engaging content that communicates our brand messaging to our target audience. The candidate must have a passion for writing and a keen eye for detail, as well as the ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop creative concepts and story ideas that effectively communicate our message to our target audience. Write clear and compelling copy that aligns with our brand messaging and tone of voice. Collaborate with our marketing, technical and creative teams to develop content for various channels, including website, social media, email, and print. Conduct research to understand our target audience and industry trends and incorporate this knowledge into the content. Edit and proofread content to ensure that it is free of errors, plagiarism and meets our quality standards. Stay up-to-date with the latest content marketing trends and techniques, and incorporate them into our content. Requirements: Graduation in English or any stream. 1 + year of experience in content writing. Exceptional writing, editing and research skills. Understanding of SEO and how it applies to content writing. Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently. Creative mindset and the ability to think outside the box. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

PREFERRED

QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience writing for B2B or technology industries like cybersecurity. Experience with content management systems such as Word Press or Hub Spot. Familiarity with social media platforms such as Linked In, Twitter, and Facebook. Sales Manager Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced Enterprise Sales Manager to join our team and drive sales efforts for our cybersecurity solutions in the enterprise and corporate market. The ideal candidate should have a proven track record of achieving sales targets, developing new business opportunities, and managing key accounts in the cybersecurity industry.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve targets for enterprise and corporate accounts. Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, influencers, and stakeholders in target accounts. Develop and manage a sales pipeline, forecasting and tracking sales activity and revenue. Collaborate with internal teams including pre-sales, customer success, marketing, and product management to ensure customer satisfaction and success. Identify market trends, competitive landscape and provide insights to internal teams. Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and other related events. Create and deliver presentations and proposals to potential customers. Requirements: Master’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of enterprise sales experience in the cybersecurity industry. Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets. Deep understanding of the cybersecurity industry, including knowledge of relevant tools such as SIEM, SOAR, UEBA, XDR etc. Strong understanding of the cybersecurity industry and its market trends. Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Willingness to travel as needed. Video Editor & Animation Job Summary: We are seeking a talented Video Editor and Animator to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for creating engaging and high-quality videos that convey our brand messaging to our target audience. The candidate must have strong technical skills in video editing and animation, as well as creativity and attention to detail.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Create and edit engaging video content that aligns with our brand and messaging. Develop creative concepts and storyboards that effectively communicate our message to our target audience. Use a variety of software tools to produce high-quality animations, micro animations and motion graphics. Collaborate with our marketing and creative teams to create video content that aligns with our overall brand strategy. Ensure that all videos are optimized for various social media platforms, including You Tube, Facebook, and Instagram. Stay up-to-date with the latest video editing and animation trends and techniques, and incorporate them into our video content. Requirements: Graduate 0 to 3 years of experience in video editing and animation. Technical skills in video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro Experience with animation software such as 3D Maya, Cinema 4D, or Blender. Knowledge of video production techniques, including lighting, sound recording, and camera operation. Ability to work independently and manage time efficiently. Good communication and collaboration skills. Digital Marketing Expert Job Description : An SEO and digital marketing professional’s job should be to develop and execute effective strategies to increase the online visibility and reach of a company’s website or digital assets, and to continuously monitor and optimize these strategies to achieve the best possible results.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Conducting keyword research and analysis to identify target keywords and phrases that are relevant to the company’s products or services. • Developing and executing SEO strategies to improve the search engine ranking and visibility of a company’s website or digital assets. • Analysing website traffic and user behaviour using tools like Google Analytics to identify areas for improvement and opportunities for optimization. • Developing and managing paid search and display advertising campaigns on platforms such as Google Ad Words, Facebook Ads, and Linked In Ads. • Developing and managing social media marketing campaigns on platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, Linked In, and Instagram. • Creating and managing email marketing campaigns to promote company products and services to customers and prospects. • Collaborating with content creators and web developers, designers to optimize website content and structure for search engine visibility and user experience. • Staying up to date with industry trends and best practices in SEO and digital marketing, and sharing knowledge and insights with team members and stakeholders. • Creating reports and presentations that communicate the results and impact of SEO and digital marketing efforts to internal and external stakeholders.
